Shaarik,
Great to hear back. I am free 9 - 11, as well as anytime after 2 Guatemala time tomorrow. On Wednesday, I can do 9-11
and 1:30 - 3. I apologize I usually have more openings. If those don't work propose something and I can try and move
things around.

On Fri, Nov 5, 2021 at 10:01 AM Shaarik [contact omitted]>wrote:
Whitney,
Forgive the delay, andthank you so much for your note. I'm a huge fan of USAID and worked closely with your agency
during my time in gov't.
It's been a bit crazy over here. We'd love a chance to hop on the phone and discuss remittances as well as our Novi
product. I'd actually like to loop in some other folks. Are their some times that work for you?
Best,
Shaarik
